mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.couple_id, t.user_id, t.event_date, t.title, t.description, t.image_url, t.created_at, u.nickname AS author FROM timeline t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY t.event_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeline (couple_id, user_id, event_date, title, description, image_url) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{userId}, #{eventDate}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM timeline WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
